reading.title: Leo Moon Meets Jupiter
overview: The Sun at 10° Scorpio conjoins Mercury while the Moon at 24° Leo conjoins Jupiter and Mars. Venus rules Libra and stands retrograde, sextile the Leo cluster. Outer planets show Neptune sextile Pluto, Uranus trine Pluto, and Saturn conjunct Neptune, all retrograde or in fall where noted.

Mundane tradition reads the Leo stellium as emphasis on leadership, display, and expansion, with the Moon-Jupiter conjunction the next aspect after a non-void Moon. The Scorpio Sun-Mercury pairing points to concentrated information and decisions. National angles receive Neptune and Saturn contacts that tradition links to institutional uncertainty or structural adjustment.

The last New Moon at Libra 17° fell in the 11th house for the United States and the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran. Current transits remain within the 35-day window that includes the next New Moon on 9 November, Mercury and Venus stations direct on 13 November, and Mars entering Virgo on 26 November.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. Tradition associates the Neptune contact with uncertainty around leadership or public standing; the Saturn-Uranus link is read as pressure for measured reform. Today's reporting on rare-earth supply risks and trade adjustments sits near these contacts but shows no measured departure from chance expectation.

Neptune squares the 1991 Sun while Mars trines the MC and natal Mars. The Neptune square is traditionally read as diffusion or misdirection around national aims; the Mars transits are read as operational activity. Reporting on drone modifications and refinery strikes aligns with the Mars contacts in location but records show no predictive gain over chance.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Neptune sextiles it, with Jupiter conjoining natal Jupiter and Mercury. The Pluto-Saturn contact is read as structural pressure; the Jupiter conjunctions as resource or diplomatic emphasis. Reporting on aid-centre strikes occurs under these transits yet matches the fair-test baseline of chance.

Pluto conjoins the natal Moon and ASC while Saturn opposes the Sun. Tradition reads the Pluto conjunction as deep institutional change and the Saturn opposition as constraint on authority. No specific reporting overlaps the listed transits today.

reading.lore_and_intel: Venus sextile Jupiter, Neptune sextile Pluto, Uranus trine Pluto, Mars conjunction Jupiter and Mercury square Mars overlap with reporting on ransomware, drone modifications, tanker incidents, refinery strikes and information activity, all carrying z scores above 3.8. The same aspects show no corresponding elevation in the listed national charts beyond the chance baselines already recorded for Mars afflictions, lunations and eclipses.

watch.note: New Moon at Scorpio 17°; watch for shifts in the houses it occupies by capital.
Mercury and Venus station direct; note any clarification or resumption in stalled matters.
Mars enters Virgo; observe changes in operational tempo or logistics.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions, full moons and eclipses produce no better than chance results for air-raid alarms, rocket alerts, personnel losses and magnitude-6 earthquakes. The listed transits therefore carry the same measured expectation of chance occurrence.
